review_scope: Full article plus schema partial and cover, reviewed against current primary sources in a separate pass after the Writer draft. The drawgent repository was cloned (commit 9cd201d, v0.2.1 tag 299e9443) and its README and eleven docs pages were read locally; the Tangled project page, tags page and docs pages were fetched; HN Firebase and Algolia were read for both threads; and `gh api` was used for every GitHub competitor's stars/forks/last-push. Corrections applied this pass: MCP tool count ~30 -> 24; the four Code-tab link statuses (were materially wrong: 'moved'/'stale'/'missing' meanings); the gesture table (was paraphrased and partly invented, including a double-arrow 'compare' meaning and a check-mark 'approve this' entry not in the docs) replaced with the docs' own vocabulary; HN 177/46 -> 178/48; competitor stars/push dates (excalidraw-mcp 5,427->5,487; mcp_excalidraw 2,490/2026-09-08 -> 2,509/2026-10-05; Reladraw 1,000/2026-09-07 -> 1,089/2026-10-03; Excalidraw 133,344->133,681; Show HN 408->414); the room-limits list (encrypted-room support and the excalidraw.com Firestore exception were both mis-stated); the 'at least five independent secondary write-ups' claim, which could be verified only for kenashe.ai and is now attributed and linked; the 'made publicly within a day of launch' critique attribution; and release-date wording ('four days before research date' removed). A Sources section with links was added so every source URL the receipt cites appears in the body. The binary was NOT run: no drawgent up, no MCP tool call, no room join, no CI check. No benchmark, cost or first-party result is claimed anywhere.

sources.description: Anchor repository/project page (Tangled, AT Protocol forge). Re-read 2026-10-08: README and docs cloned at commit 9cd201d (README 8d old); project page shows Star 12, Fork 2, Commits 50, language bars Rust 63.8% / JavaScript 31.9% / CSS 2.4% / Shell 0.8%; tags page shows the single tag v0.2.1 dated 8d/1 week ago; Cargo.toml version = 0.2.1.

README.md at main (8.6 kB). Source for: single static binary, the 0.2.1 install/download table and macOS notarization note, 'no Node.js, no Docker', the `drawgent setup <agent>` / `drawgent up [--attach]` quick start, and the Limits list (Chrome renderer; Claude --attach is a fork; Codex live attach untested; macOS cross-compiled and never run on a real Mac; rooms/self-hosted image sync).
requirements line: 'Linux (x86_64 or arm64) or macOS 13 or later. No Node.js, no Docker.'

Config/CLI reference. Source for: `--port` default 7300; `--room-name` default `🤖 Agent`; `--settle-ms` default 2500; `drawgent check` exits 1 on broken links and `--fix` repairs moved symbols and renamed files; the MCP tools table (24 tools across Reading / Drawing / Notes and status / Boards / Code, with the 5 code tools omitted in canvas-only mode); the REST API on the same port.

Code links (file + line range + symbol), the Code-tab status table (✅ ok / ↕ moved / ⚠ stale / ❌ missing), `drawgent check --fix`, the repo map (treemap, files sized by line count), and Build what I drew (📝 planned → 🔧 in progress → ✅ done, ⛔ blocked).

Agent coverage and bridges: Claude Code (built-in bridge over `claude -p` stream-json), Codex (built-in bridge over `codex app-server`), opencode (native ACP), any ACP agent via `drawgent serve --agent mine='my-acp-agent --stdio'`; `--attach` fork/live semantics; permission modes canvas|ask|all; drawing guide 'adapted from the official excalidraw-mcp guide (MIT)'.

The full gesture vocabulary (circle/scribble, arrow A→B, line, zigzag, ✓, tap/✕, ↔/↕), the task lists each gesture offers, the 'two seconds after your last stroke' poll with 2-3 tasks plus Other, and the rule that code tasks are only offered when the zone holds code-linked shapes.

Room model and its Limits section (a browser must have the document open; only documents in a live collaboration room work; private documents often open none so drawgent waits forever; password-protected documents unsupported; excalidraw.com's {key} rooms are supported and AES-GCM encrypted; Firestore storage for excalidraw.com so drawgent can work alone there; main board only, images/files not synced).

Chat panel, AGENT: notes (fired after ~2.5 s, answered with a green DONE: note), undo (Ctrl+Z, per-turn Undo, undo_changes), several boards, and clean diffable `.excalidraw` files kept in the repository via `--diagram`.
The Firefox sidebar extension: manifest_version 3, `sidebar_action` with the panel view, localhost/127.0.0.1 host permissions. Source for the MV3 sidebar claim.
